questions.q_en: Which Rashtrakuta ruler took the title "Jagattunga" and extended the empire from the Himalayas to Cape Comorin?

• He expanded the empire both diplomatically and militarily, gaining control over vast territories.

• His title "Jagattunga" means "prominent in the world."

• Krishna III: Was a powerful ruler but not associated with expansion up to the Himalayas.

• Amoghavarsha I: Focused more on cultural patronage and religious activities.

• Indra III: Defeated Mahipala of Kanauj.

questions.q_en:
Consider the following statements regarding the Rashtrakuta Empire. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

a) The Rashtrakutas acted as a bridge between north and south India in both economic and cultural aspects.

b) The Rashtrakutas adopted and expanded north Indian traditions and policies in south India.

c) The Rashtrakuta rule never extended beyond the Deccan region.
questions.solution_en:
• The Rashtrakutas played a crucial role in linking the north and south in terms of economic and cultural exchanges.

• The empire promoted several traditions and policies originating in north India and implemented them in the south.

• The Rashtrakuta empire extended its control beyond the Deccan, reaching both northern and southern India.
questions.solution_hi:
• The Rashtrakutas played a crucial role in linking the north and south in terms of economic and cultural exchanges.

• The empire promoted several traditions and policies originating in north India and implemented them in the south.

• The Rashtrakuta empire extended its control beyond the Deccan, reaching both northern and southern India.
